note: Brief 060 tier 2: the rows the nightly `bun run qa --nightly` plays in the built player (`-bot`, BotRun.cs), one player per row, at real time (~10 min each with boot). A row's seed is mixed with the night's date (tools/qa/bot.ts nightSeed), so each night plays new games; the report says each seed. Policies choose only from the ring the game builds: random (any agent, any thing on screen, any wedge, walks, runs, turns), greedy (the way that moves the mission on, cheapest first), cautious (no violence, no Trail; Watch and Listen first).
